close_reason: reqwest::Client moved to MtaStsEnforcer struct, built once at startup
description: mta_sts_fetcher.rs fetch_url() calls reqwest::Client::builder()...build() on every invocation. reqwest::Client holds a connection pool and TLS session cache; it is designed to be constructed once and reused. Rebuilding per call discards the pool, re-loads TLS roots, and re-initialises the connector on every MTA-STS policy fetch. Fix: thread a &reqwest::Client parameter through fetch_url and fetch_mta_sts_policy_body, or hold a Client in MtaStsEnforcer.
title: fetch_url rebuilds reqwest::Client on every policy fetch
